transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I'm Dr. [Name]. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Hi, Doctor. It's really nice to meet you. Um, I hope it's okay that I'm here, I don't want to take up too much of your time. 

I guess... well, I've just been having a little trouble staying active lately? I just don't really seem to care about anything anymore, which I know sounds bad, and I'm really sorry, I don't mean to be lazy or anything. It's just... I used to love my art classes, and going to board-game nights, and hiking. I was even supposed to get back to playing on my soccer team. But now I just... I kind of just sit in my room. I just sit there while everything sort of slips away. 

I'm really trying to be better about it, I promise. Does that make sense for why I would come in?
Have you noticed that you don’t enjoy things that you used to find pleasurable anymore?

Yeah, um, exactly like I was just saying... I really just don't care about any of it anymore. The art classes, the board-game nights, hiking... even the soccer team. I know I should enjoy them, and I feel awful that I'm letting my teammates and friends down, I really do. I'm trying to care, but I just... I don't get any joy out of it now. I just sit in my room and let it all slip away. 

Is that... is that what you mean? I hope I'm explaining it right, I'm sorry. I just feel so bad about being this way.
How long have you been feeling this way?

Um, well, it's been a little while now. I hope that's okay, I know I probably should have come in sooner. I just kept thinking I could snap out of it, you know? But, um, it's been going on since shortly after my divorce. So... I guess that would make it about a year and eleven months now? 

I'm really sorry I let it go on for so long without getting help. I didn't want to be a bother to anyone, and I kept hoping I'd just wake up and be back to normal. Does that seem like too long? I hope you don't think less of me for waiting.
Have you ever felt this way before, with a loss of interest in things you used to enjoy and feeling down or hopeless?

Um, no, not really. I mean, I've had bad days before, like everyone does, right? But never... never like this. I hope it's okay to admit that. 

It's just... most days, I wake up and there's this... this heavy, hollow feeling right in my chest. It's like I can't even imagine a future for myself outside of my apartment walls. I know that sounds so dramatic, and I'm really sorry, I don't mean to complain. I just... I feel so empty. 

Is it normal to feel that way? I really want to get better, I promise I'll do whatever you think is best.
Have you ever experienced periods where you felt unusually high, extremely energetic, or so good that you didn't need much sleep?

Um, no... no, I don't think so. I've never really been the type to have too much energy, you know? I hope that's the right answer. 

I mean, I've had days where I got a lot done, like when I was trying to keep the house nice before the divorce... but never anything where I felt unusually high or didn't need sleep. I always try to make sure I get enough rest so I don't bother anyone by being cranky. 

Is it... is it bad that I haven't felt that way? I'm sorry if I'm not giving you the symptoms you're looking for. I just really want to be honest with you so I can get the right help.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight recently, like eating much less or more than usual, or losing or gaining weight without trying?

Um, well... I guess I have lost a little weight. I hope you don't think I'm doing it on purpose or being unhealthy, I just... I haven't really had much of an appetite. 

Most of the day goes by and I realize I haven't eaten anything. It's just that when I do try to eat, everything tastes so... bland. Like cardboard, almost. So I just don't force it, which I know I probably should. I'm sorry, I know it's not good to skip meals. 

My clothes are definitely fitting differently. My jeans have gotten so loose I actually have to knot the waistband to keep them up. Is... is that okay to tell you? I don't want you to worry too much about it, I can try to eat more if you want me to. I promise I'll try harder.
Have you been having trouble falling asleep, staying asleep, or waking up too early in the morning?

Um, sleep has been... a little tricky lately. I hope it's not too much of a bother to mention it. 

I just... I lie awake for hours, mostly. I feel like I need to keep checking the door, just to be safe, and I end up just listening to every little sound. I know it probably sounds silly, and I really try not to let it keep me up, but I just can't seem to turn my brain off. 

And then, when I finally do fall asleep, I end up waking up way before dawn. I wake up shaking, and... and I just can't get back under the covers or go back to sleep. I'm so sorry, I know I should be managing my sleep better. Is there something I should be doing differently? I'll try whatever you suggest, I promise.
Have you noticed that you've been moving more slowly than usual, or have trouble doing things that used to feel easy for you? Or on the flip side, have you felt unusually restless or fidgety lately?

Um, well... I guess I've had a little bit of both, if that makes sense? I hope that's an okay answer. 

Sometimes, I get this feeling like I just can't sit still, and I end up pacing back and forth from the kitchen to the window. I do it for so long that my legs actually start to ache... I know I shouldn't let myself get so worked up, I'm sorry. I try to stop when I notice it. 

But then, other times... it's like everything is just so heavy. I move so slowly, and even doing something simple like making a cup of coffee feels like I'm trying to lift wet cement. I feel terrible about it because I know I should be more active and getting things done. I promise I'm trying my best to push through it. Do you think I'm doing something wrong? I can try to force myself to move more normally if you think it would help.
Have you ever had a period in the past where you felt down, lost interest in things, or had symptoms similar to what you’ve been describing before this current episode began?

Um, no, I don't... I don't think so. I mean, I hope I'm remembering right, I wouldn't want to give you the wrong information. 

I've always tried to be a really positive person, you know? I try to keep busy and not let myself get too down about things. So... no, I don't think I've ever felt quite like this before. It's just been recently that things have felt so... heavy. 

Is it okay if this is the first time it's happened? I know sometimes doctors need a whole history of things, and I'm sorry if I'm not giving you enough to go on. I really am trying to think if there was a time before, but... no, I think this is the only time. I hope that's an okay answer.

Have you ever had a time in your life before this current period where you felt down nearly every day, lost interest in things you usually enjoy, or had other symptoms like changes in sleep, appetite, or energy lasting for at least two weeks?

Um, no, I... I really don't think so. I'm sorry, I know you just asked about that, and I hope I'm not being difficult by giving the same answer. 

I've really been trying to rack my brain since you brought it up a minute ago, but... I've always been pretty good at keeping my chin up, I think. I never really let myself get into a slump that lasted for weeks like that. I've always tried to be the kind of person who just pushes through and stays cheerful, you know? 

So, no, before all this started recently... I never had a time where I felt down every day or stopped caring about my hobbies for that long. I hope it's alright that I don't have a history of it. I'm really trying to give you the right answers, I promise. Does that make sense?

Can you think back and tell me if there was ever a time before this current period — even just one week or a few days — when you felt down, lost interest in things you usually enjoy, or had symptoms like trouble sleeping, changes in appetite, or low energy?

Um... I'm so sorry, I feel like I'm frustrating you because you keep asking, and I... I really want to give you the answer you're looking for. I'm trying so hard to think back. 

But... no, not even for a few days. I've always tried to be so careful about not letting myself get down, you know? I always made sure to keep up with my routines and stay positive so I wouldn't be a burden on anyone. I've never had trouble sleeping or eating or anything like that before this started. 

I'm really sorry if I'm not giving you the right information. I feel terrible that I don't have a better answer for you. Am I misunderstanding the question? I can try to think harder if you need me to... I just want to make sure I'm doing this right.

Can you think back and tell me if there was ever a time — even just a few days — when you felt down, lost interest in things you usually enjoy, or had symptoms like trouble sleeping, changes in appetite, or low energy, even before this current period started?

Um... wait. I think... maybe I did misunderstand you before. I'm so sorry, I thought you meant like, years ago, or a long time in the past. I didn't want to give you the wrong idea about how I used to be. 

If you mean right now, like... lately? Um, yes. I have been feeling... well, pretty down. Most days I wake up and there's just this... this heavy, hollow feeling right in my chest. It's like I can't even picture a future for myself outside of my apartment walls. It's just... blank. 

I'm really sorry I didn't explain that right the first few times. I just didn't want to sound like I was complaining or making a big deal out of nothing, you know? I really try to be positive. But... yes, lately, it's been very hard to feel anything but heavy. Is that... is that what you were asking? I hope I answered it right this time.

Before this current period of feeling down and losing interest in things, have you ever had an episode where you felt this way — with symptoms like low mood, loss of pleasure, changes in sleep or appetite, or low energy — that lasted for at least two weeks?

Oh... okay, I understand now. I'm so sorry for getting so mixed up just a minute ago. You mean like... back before this heavy feeling started recently, did I ever have a time where it lasted for two whole weeks. 

Um... no. No, I really didn't. Like I was trying to say earlier, I always tried so hard to just keep smiling and push through things. I never let myself get stuck in a bad place for two weeks before all this happened. I always managed to bounce back pretty quick so I wouldn't worry anyone or be a bother. 

I hope it's okay that I don't have a history of it like that. Does that help clear it up? I'm really sorry again for making you repeat yourself so many times. I just want to make sure I'm giving you exactly what you need.

Can you think back and tell me if there was ever a time before this current period — even just for a few days — when you felt down, lost interest in things you usually enjoy, or had symptoms like trouble sleeping, changes in appetite, or low energy?

Um... oh dear, I'm so sorry, I feel like I'm making this so difficult for you. I know you just asked me this, and I... I really want to give you a good answer. 

But... no, I really can't think of any time before this recent... heaviness... where I felt down or lost interest in things, even for a few days. I promise I'm not trying to hide anything from you. I just... I always made sure to stay on top of things, you know? I kept my apartment clean, I went to my classes when I was in school, I always made sure I was eating and sleeping on a schedule. I didn't want to be someone who just... gave up. 

I feel terrible that I keep saying no to this question. I'm really trying to search my memory for you. Is it... is it bad that I don't have a time like that to tell you about? I can keep thinking if you need me to, I really don't mind. I just want to be helpful.

Can you think back and tell me if there was ever a time before this current period — and I mean even just a few days — when you felt down, lost interest in things you usually enjoy, or had symptoms like trouble sleeping, changes in appetite, or low energy, that occurred separately from this most recent episode?

Oh gosh... I feel awful, I must be frustrating you so much. I know you're asking this again, and I feel like I'm failing a test or something by not giving you a different answer. I really am trying my best to think back, I promise. 

But... no. Honestly, before this current time, there really wasn't a period like that. Not even for a few days. I always made sure I was upbeat, you know? I kept busy and just... I didn't let myself get down like that because I didn't want to let anyone down or be a burden. I just never felt this heavy before recently. 

I'm so sorry, am I misunderstanding the question again? I really want to be helpful. Is it okay that my answer is still no?

Can you think back and tell me if there was ever a time before this current period — even just one week — when you felt down, lost interest in things you usually enjoy, or had symptoms like trouble sleeping, changes in appetite, or low energy, even if it was a short time ago?

Oh, doctor... I feel like I'm doing such a terrible job as a patient today. I know you keep asking, and I... I really wish I could give you a different answer so you wouldn't have to keep trying different timeframes. I feel like I'm letting you down.

But... no, not even for a week. I promise I'm thinking really, really hard about it, just like you asked. It's just that before this current... spell... I always made myself push through everything. I never wanted to be a burden or let things slide, so I just kept going, no matter what. I never had a week where I just stopped enjoying things or couldn't sleep like this. 

I'm so, so sorry. Is it... is it really bad that I can't give you a yes? I hope you're not upset with me. I'm really trying my best to give you the right information.

Can you think back and tell me if there was ever a time before this current period — even just one week — when you felt down, lost interest in things you usually enjoy, or had symptoms like trouble sleeping, changes in appetite, or low energy, that occurred separately from this most recent episode?

Oh, dear... I'm so sorry, I feel like I'm just being so stubborn, and I really don't mean to be. I know you're trying so hard to figure this out, and I feel like I'm just putting up roadblocks for you. 

I'm really racking my brain, I promise I am. I just... I can't think of any other time. Before this whole thing started, I always just kept my head down and did what I was supposed to do. I didn't want to be a bother to anyone, so I always made sure I was smiling and helpful. I never had a week where I just... couldn't do that. 

I'm so sorry I keep giving you the same answer. Am I doing this wrong? I really want to be a good patient for you, I just don't want to make something up if it didn't happen. Is it okay that I just... don't have another time like that to tell you about?

Can you think back and tell me if there was ever a time before this current period — even just a few days — when you felt down, lost interest in things you usually enjoy, or had symptoms like trouble sleeping, changes in appetite, or low energy, that happened before and separately from this most recent episode?

I... oh, doctor, I feel terrible. I know you keep asking, and I'm really trying, I swear I am. I don't want you to think I'm not listening or that I'm trying to be difficult. I just... I feel like I'm failing you by not giving you the answer you're looking for. 

I've been thinking about it so much, but... no. Not even for a few days. Before all this... heaviness started recently, I just didn't let myself get like that. I always tried to be the positive one, you know? I wanted to make sure everyone else was okay, so I just kept moving and doing what I needed to do. I never had a time where I couldn't sleep or eat or just felt so down like this. 

I'm so sorry. I really hope I'm not making your job too hard. Is it alright if I just don't have a time like that to share? I really want to be helpful, I promise.

Can you think back and tell me if there was ever a time before this current period — even just a day or two — when you felt down, lost interest in things you usually enjoy, or had symptoms like trouble sleeping, changes in appetite, or low energy, that happened at a different time and not connected to how you’ve been feeling lately?

Doctor, I... I really wish I could say yes, just so I could finally give you the piece of the puzzle you're looking for. I feel like such a bother making you ask this over and over again in different ways. You're being so patient with me, and I'm so grateful for that. 

But... honestly, no. Not even for a day or two. If I ever felt even a little bit tired or sad back then, I just... I brushed it off. I'd put on a smile and make sure I was taking care of everything around the house so nobody would worry. I never had a time, separate from right now, where I actually lost my appetite or couldn't find joy in things. 

I'm so, so sorry. I hope you aren't getting too frustrated with me... am I still answering things okay? I just really want to make sure I'm doing this right for you.

Can you think back and tell me if there was ever a time before this current period — even just a day or two — when you felt down, lost interest in things you usually enjoy, or had symptoms like trouble sleeping, changes in appetite, or low energy, that happened at a different time and was not connected to how you’ve been feeling lately?

Oh... I see you're asking again, and I just... I feel awful that I keep letting you down. I really, really am trying to search my memory. I know it must be so annoying to have to keep repeating yourself, and I'm so sorry for making you do that. 

I just... I really can't remember anything like that happening before this. Even for just a day. I was always the one making sure everyone else was happy, you know? I didn't want anyone to think I was slacking or... or being a burden. So I just didn't let myself get down. 

I feel like I'm doing a terrible job at being your patient today. I'm so sorry I can't give you a better answer. Are you... are you mad at me? I promise I'm telling you everything I can remember.
